comparisons.name: grid-pair-light
comparisons.description: General and Desktop & Screen Saver in the System Preferences grid, Aqua. The artwork is masked: the example draws a stand-in block, not Apple's icons.

comparisons.name: grid-pair-light-masked
comparisons.description: As grid-pair-light with the captions masked too, which are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms: scores the band alone, to show that the slot draws nothing else.

comparisons.name: rest-light
comparisons.description: An enabled and a disabled pane at rest, Aqua.

pixels.note: the artwork fills the 40 pt allocation, 5 pt under the slot's top edge and centred in its 82 pt (spec: Geometry, measured pitch and inferred allocation)
no bezel or background beside the artwork (spec: Anatomy, transparent hit rectangle, measured)
disabled: the artwork at half opacity over the page (spec: States, disabled, inferred)

comparisons.name: pressed-light
comparisons.description: The pane held down with the mouse, Aqua.

pixels.note: the artwork darkened to 70% (spec: States, pressed: image-button darkening, inferred)
no pressed bezel appears around it

comparisons.name: focus-ring-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the pane, reached with Tab, Aqua.

pixels.note: ring over the page around the 40 pt artwork allocation, measured on a text field (spec: focus-ring, sRGB; States, focused, inferred)
page just outside the 3 pt ring

comparisons.name: window-inactive-light
comparisons.description: The same after Tab in an inactive window, Aqua.

pixels.note: no focus ring outside the key window (spec: focus-ring, States)
the artwork keeps its colour in an inactive window

comparisons.name: long-title-light
comparisons.description: Titles of more than two lines, one written with three line breaks and one that wraps, Aqua: each caption is cut after its second line, so the slots keep their 85 pt and a grid's rows do not overlap.

pixels.note: the 5 pt of clear space under the second caption line of the first slot holds no third line (spec: Geometry, 82 x 85 pt slot, two caption lines)
the same under the caption that wraps
